proposed_widenings.name: Attachment area shape: wall
proposed_widenings.justification: Blade Barrier creates a wall (straight or ringed), not a sphere. The current Attachment area shape union only includes sphere. A wall variant with linear (length × height × thickness) and ring (diameter × height × thickness) sub-shapes is required.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You make a straight wall up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a ringed wall up to 60 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick.

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation: save_gate_on_contact
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell deals damage through a DEX save gate that fires when a creature is in the area, enters it, or ends its turn there. Neither existing OngoingOperation variant covers this: roll_modifier modifies dice on rolls, damage_on_hit fires when the caster scores an attack-roll hit. A new variant is needed for a repeating save gate triggered by creature contact with a persistent area.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Any creature in the wall's space makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d10 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature also makes that save if it enters the wall's space or ends its turn there.

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation save_gate_on_contact: once_per_turn cap
proposed_widenings.justification: The save fires at most once per turn per creature regardless of how many times the creature crosses or remains in the area. This is a frequency cap distinct from the per-hit usageLimit on mastery and needs to be expressible on the new operation variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature makes that save only once per turn.

notes: The ongoing_effect family is the correct family (concentration, persistent area, repeated triggering). Both gaps are in the OngoingOperation and Attachment shape unions — no new families or source-root atoms are required. Secondary effects (Three-Quarters Cover, Difficult Terrain) are environmental and are not the blocking issue; they would require separate widening passes if modeled.
